disclaimer: Cited craft rules for headless exam. Not a lecture and not a production gate.

items.rule: A scene states a want; the need is what the character actually requires.
items.counter_example: A scene that is only atmosphere with no desire.
items.apply: Name the want on this scene.

items.rule: Coverage holds the 180-degree axis unless a crossing is motivated.
items.counter_example: Reverse coverage that flips eyelines with no geography.
items.apply: Check shot sizes and eyelines on this scene.
